title: Provider Manual — Attendants, Visit Verification and Backup Plans in Care Management
content:
This chapter of the Care Management provider manual sets out, tier by tier, who may serve as a member's attendant, whether delivered hours must be confirmed by electronic visit verification (EVV), how long a missing EVV record may still be corrected, how quickly an agency reports a missed personal care visit, whether a documented backup attendant plan is required, and how many training hours are offered to an unpaid family caregiver each year.

## Provisions by tier

| Care Management tier | Member may direct their own attendant | Relative not legally responsible for the member may be paid as attendant | Delivered hours confirmed by EVV | Missing EVV record correctable within (calendar days after the visit date) | Agency reports a missed personal care visit within (hours) | Documented backup attendant plan required | Training hours for an unpaid family caregiver per year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Healthy Living Support | No | No | No | 0 | 0 | No | 0.00 |
| Care Coordination Level 1 | No | No | No | 0 | 0 | No | 0.00 |
| Care Coordination Level 2 | No | No | No | 0 | 0 | No | 0.00 |
| Maternal Care Management | No | No | No | 0 | 0 | No | 0.00 |
| Complex Case Management | No | No | No | 0 | 0 | No | 0.00 |
| Health Home Services | No | No | No | 0 | 0 | No | 0.00 |
| LTSS Service Coordination | Yes | Yes | Yes | 14 | 24 | Yes | 8.00 |

## Notes for agencies

1. LTSS Service Coordination is the one tier in which every provision in the table is in effect: self-direction, a paid relative who is not legally responsible for the member, EVV, a 14-day correction window, a 24-hour missed-visit report, a documented backup attendant plan and 8.00 training hours a year for an unpaid family caregiver.
2. The correction window is counted in calendar days after the visit date.
3. The missed-visit figure is the number of hours within which the agency reports a missed personal care visit.

## Dates worked (hypothetical)

- A visit on 4 March whose EVV record is missing may be corrected within 14 calendar days after the visit date, that is, through 18 March.
- A personal care visit missed at 9:00 on a Tuesday is reported by the agency within 24 hours, by 9:00 on the Wednesday.
